answer: Seed the ledger with canary answers: sable decoys that look like valid work but are subtly poisoned. An honest grader at any vertex of the attestation graph spots and rejects them; a Sybil farm's bots, which blind-countersign their own cluster to fake quorum, swallow them. Every canary a clone signs is logged and slashes its bond. With seeding rate p, N forced attestations cost about pN burns, so the more vertices you spin up to reach the quorum horizon, the more traps you trip, and the attack's price climbs faster than its yield.
